newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cerj started as sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cerj started as sell.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it started coverage of Rio de Janeiro state power utility Cerj with a sell recommendation.
-- It said it believes Cerj, expected to be privatized soon, will face a turnaround process after its selloff which will be arduous and costly, "thereby underpinning our sell recommendation."
-- Cerj is Rio de Janeiro's second largest electricity distributor and is due to be privatized on November 20, it said.
-- Cerj common shares traded at 0.51 reais, down 1.92 percent, at 1700 local/1900 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
